correctness.rationale: Rectangular-band multiplication gives (X⋆Y)_(il)=r_i(X)c_l(Y) and [X,Y]=r(X)c(Y)^t-r(Y)c(X)^t, forcing coefficient-array rank≤2 in any characteristic. Row/column vectors of same element have identical total; the image W is codimension one in Fq^m⊕Fq^n, every fiber q^h with h=(m-1)(n-1). Counting centralizer fibers by whether row/column sums vanish yields N0=q^(2h)K. Rank two iff both ordered row vectors and both ordered column vectors are independent; prescribing common two-vector of totals gives F_d^(0)=(q^(d-1)-1)(q^(d-1)-q) and F_d^(*)=q^(d-1)(q^(d-1)-1), thus N2=q^(2h)(F_m^(0)F_n^(0)+(q²-1)F_m^(*)F_n^(*)); N1 by subtraction. The open dense rank-two locus exists for m,n≥2, not if min=1. Independently enumerated all pairs by original four-index product over F2 for (2,2): 88/120/48 and (2,3): 832/2112/1152 at ranks 0/1/2; agrees. The algebraic count, not finite tests, proves arbitrary prime powers and dimensions.
